subject: Group demo: host-lane queue and time options for multi-prospect showcase
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Alice Chen <alice@acme-retail.com>, Bob Singh <bob@storix.io>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Group demo: host-lane queue and time options for multi-prospect showcase

Hi all —

Quick coordination note as we lock the group demo for next week. We have two prospects (Acme Retail and Storix) who asked to join the same office-hours-style showcase; rather than run back-to-back 1:1s, I want to run a 60-minute multi-org session and allocate 2 host lanes: one for platform/product deep-dive, one for integration/sizing. Goal: keep total live time to 60 mins, vendors get 10–15 min Q&A each.

Proposed time options (PST):
- Option A: Wed 11/11, 10:30–11:30 PT
- Option B: Thu 11/12, 16:00–17:00 PT (preferred for Acme EMEA attendees)

Suggested host-lane assignments (please confirm):
- Lane 1 (runtime & perf): Ben 
- Lane 2 (integration & deployment variants): Marissa

Operational asks:
- Ben: confirm you can cover the perf demo + 5-minute cold start benchmark (I’ll surface the perf artifacts).
- Marissa: can you bring the Dedicated vs Private decision tree slide and a quick cadence for rollouts?
- Rishi: pricing/contract brief (3–4 min) and a recommended next step for both accounts.
- Vivek: can you own the bridge + backup host in case someone needs to drop?

Attachments: prospect_list.csv (mapping of attendees / timezone / role), group-demo-runbook.md (draft runbook with minute-by-minute plan).

If we need to split to two smaller sessions, we can do so but would prefer the single consolidated hour if both prospects can attend. Please reply with lane confirmations + your preferred option (A/B).

Thanks —
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
[attachment: prospect_list.csv (CSV, 18KB)]
[attachment: group-demo-runbook.md (MD, 6KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Group demo: host-lane queue and time options for multi-prospect showcase

Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear plan. I can take Lane 1 and will bring a compact perf demo (cold start + 95th p50 p90 numbers) and a short microbenchmark script we can run live if we have 10 minutes. If time is tight I can collapse perf into a 7-minute segment.

Option A works for me but Option B is fine if we need broader coverage for EMEA; I’ll adjust the demo to avoid heavy checkpoints if we end up at 4pm PT.

Two quick asks:
- Can someone add the meeting to the account records in HubSpot? I want the logging to include which template runbook we used.
- If we go with Option B, I'll need the bridge URL + presenter controls 30 mins before.

Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks — we landed on Option B (Thu 11/12, 16:00–17:00 PT) after quick sync with Acme; Storix confirmed they can join late-EMEA friendly times. I updated the runbook with a subtle lane swap so integration follows perf (so we can show a live perf moment, then immediately demo integration/ops).

Changes I made (runbook v1.1 attached):
- 00:00–05:00 Intro + customer intros (Kimberly intro + agenda)
- 05:00–20:00 Lane 1 (Ben) perf demo + microbenchmark
- 20:00–35:00 Lane 2 (Marissa) integration walkthrough + deployment matrix
- 35:00–45:00 Rishi pricing + next steps
- 45:00–60:00 Open Q&A and close (both prospects)

Vivek: I put you as primary bridge owner; please drop the Google Meet bridge and the presenter rights in the calendar event.

Kimberly: I bumped the HubSpot event (link below). Please confirm you want me to record the session for the accounts. If so, I'll toggle recording and upload the MP4 to the deal record.

External note to Alice & Bob: thanks for being flexible on time — we'll send a final calendar invite with the bridge and a short pre-read. Expect the invite within the hour.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
